stories.event: President Isaac Herzog said after consultations ended on 5 Nov that he will decide on Sunday 8 Nov who gets the mandate to form Israel's next government. Gadi Eisenkot has 67 recommendations, including 19 from Arab-led parties he will not govern with, against 46 for Benjamin Netanyahu; Herzog warned of 'mutual vetoes' and pressed for a unity government. The legal limit is 11 Nov and the new Knesset is sworn in on 10 Nov.
